data.name: send_intro
data.value: Choose files, a folder, or write a message. Select a paired device to send.

data.name: drop
data.value: Or drop files and folders here

data.name: message_hint
data.value: Paste a link or write a short message

data.name: pair_intro
data.value: Scan this code in HopDrop on your phone, or enter the other device's pairing link.

data.name: no_address
data.value: No local address found. Connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

data.name: language_intro
data.value: Choose the language used by HopDrop.

data.name: ask
data.value: Ask before receiving from untrusted devices

data.name: close_tray
data.value: Keep receiving when I close the window

data.name: close_tray_note
data.value: Requires a working system tray. Use Quit in the tray menu to stop HopDrop.

data.name: capability
data.value: Files stay between your devices. Use your local network, a HopDrop hotspot, or paired Bluetooth devices.

data.name: match_code
data.value: Check that these numbers match on both devices:

data.name: qr_expires
data.value: This code expires after 5 minutes. Keep this window open while pairing.

data.name: no_paired
data.value: No paired devices yet. Pair a device to start sending.

data.name: invalid_address
data.value: Enter a valid IPv4 address and port.

data.name: connection_note
data.value: Both devices must be on the same local network or hotspot.

data.name: waiting_device
data.value: Device is unavailable. Keep HopDrop open and try again when it reconnects.

data.name: error_network
data.value: Could not reach the device. Check that HopDrop is open and both devices are on the same network.

data.name: error_not_paired
data.value: Pair this device again before sending.

data.name: error_identity
data.value: This is not the device you paired with. Pair it again.

data.name: error_declined
data.value: The other device declined the transfer.

data.name: error_space
data.value: The receiving device does not have enough free space.

data.name: error_file
data.value: Could not read or save the file. Check permissions and free space.

data.name: error_protocol
data.value: Update HopDrop on both devices, then try again.

data.name: error_unknown
data.value: Could not complete the operation. Check the connection and try again.

data.name: error_identity_storage
data.value: Could not open the saved device identity. Unlock your keyring and check access to HopDrop's data folder.

data.name: queued
data.value: Waiting for the device to reconnect

data.name: queue_note
data.value: Offline sends stay here after you close HopDrop. You can cancel them at any time.

data.name: queue_interrupted
data.value: Interrupted before HopDrop closed. Review before retrying.

data.name: retry_note
data.value: Some files may already have arrived. Retry this send?

data.name: clear_history_note
data.value: Clear this activity list? Received files will stay on disk.

data.name: start_session
data.value: Start HopDrop when I sign in

data.name: background_note
data.value: Starts with your desktop session and keeps HopDrop running after the window closes. Quit from the tray to stop receiving.

data.name: file_manager
data.value: Add “Send with HopDrop” to the file manager

data.name: file_manager_note
data.value: Supports Mint’s Nemo, Nautilus scripts, and Dolphin service menus. The selection opens in HopDrop for you to choose a recipient.

data.name: clipboard_receive
data.value: Copy received clipboard text to my clipboard

data.name: clipboard_share
data.value: Automatically share copied text with nearby Android devices

data.name: clipboard_warning
data.value: Copied text is sent to your paired Android devices while they are nearby. Password formats marked private are skipped; other apps may not mark sensitive text. Keep this off when copying secrets.

data.name: clipboard_wayland
data.value: Automatic clipboard sharing is unavailable in Wayland sessions. Use “Paste clipboard text” on the Send page to choose what to send.

data.name: agents_note
data.value: Allow local agents running as your user to list paired devices, send selected files, and read transfer activity. Agents cannot pair devices, change settings, or approve incoming files.

data.name: backup_note
data.value: Android folder backups arrive here, keeping their folder structure. Changing this location affects future backups.

data.name: forget_note
data.value: Remove this backup from the list? Its files will stay on disk.

data.name: hotspot_note
data.value: Create a temporary Wi-Fi hotspot for a phone that is not on your network. This uses NetworkManager and an adapter that supports hotspot mode.

data.name: hotspot_disconnect
data.value: Starting the hotspot on this adapter may disconnect your current Wi-Fi network. Continue?

data.name: hotspot_confirm
data.value: Start a temporary HopDrop hotspot? Scan the pairing code on your phone to join it.

data.name: radio_unavailable
data.value: The required wireless hardware or system service is unavailable. Check NetworkManager for Wi-Fi, or BlueZ and its OBEX service for Bluetooth.

data.name: bluetooth_note
data.value: Uses the system’s paired Bluetooth devices. Delivery is recorded only after BlueZ confirms it. Native incoming Bluetooth transfers are handled by Blueman and cannot be added to HopDrop activity.

data.name: bluetooth_receive_note
data.value: Accept incoming files in Blueman’s system interface. HopDrop cannot confirm those transfers or add them to its activity list.

data.name: bluetooth_receive_unavailable
data.value: A powered Bluetooth adapter, BlueZ OBEX, and Blueman with its transfer plugin are required.

data.name: bluetooth_files_only
data.value: Select one or more files first. Bluetooth does not preserve folders; use the local network or hotspot to send folders.

data.name: bluetooth_pair_first
data.value: Pair the receiving device in the system Bluetooth settings first.

data.name: bluetooth_unconfirmed
data.value: Delivery could not be confirmed. Check the receiving device before retrying.

data.name: bluetooth_failed
data.value: Bluetooth could not deliver the file. Check pairing, receiver consent, and the system Bluetooth service.

data.name: updates_note
data.value: Linux updates are installed from a new package. Open the release page to check available builds.
